articles.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
articles.snippet: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

articles.title: Smaller altcoins shine as bitcoin stills trades around $85,000
articles.snippet: Leading the gains is BTW, the native token of Bitway, a bitcoin-compatible layer-1, which jumped 25% in the past 24 hours and is up 170% over the past 30 days.

articles.title: An XRP treasury SPAC surges nearly 300% ahead of Evernorth merger
articles.snippet: Armada Acquisition Corp. II rose about 270% last week, leaving the thinly traded shell at nearly four times its roughly $10.50 trust value before merging with Evernorth, an XPR treasury company.

articles.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
articles.snippet: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

articles.title: Ondo opens private markets with tokenized pre-IPO AI exposure
articles.snippet: Ondo’s tokenized notes will give eligible investors exposure to private companies, with the first tied to an unnamed pre-IPO AI company.
